title: Dispatch: 91o0 subclass choice coverage + modeling (Sonnet 5.5, attempt 1)
description:
Implementation dispatch for eshyra-91o0 (choice-coverage gate skips subclass-granted features). Model: Sonnet 5.5 (Claude Agent). Worktree .worktrees/eshyra-91o0.1 on branch eshyra-91o0.1, cut from eshyra-91o0 (= origin/main 1d54e7b1). Run `npm ci` in the worktree first. READ FIRST: eshyra-91o0 description and notes (the proof boundary is the COMPLETE applicable grant graph), docs/importer-fix-protocol.md, docs/rules-pack-compiler.md. Importer protocol applies: never weaken an audit expectation to match generated output.

CODE SURVEY (origin/main 1d54e7b1):
- packages/core/src/rules/srdPlayabilityAudit.ts: checkChoiceCoverage() and checkSubclassChoiceCoverage() iterate grantedClassFeatureLevels(pack), which reads ONLY class progression featureGrant rows. Subclass-granted features (subclass records -> their feature refs/levels) are never audited. CHOICE_SIGNALS (regex per category + owning bead) are the prose detectors.
- packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/deriveFeatureChoices.ts: curated choices. spellFilter() helper at ~306; feature:college-of-lore:additional-magical-secrets at ~415 is the pattern for a spell/cantrip choice.
- packages/core/src/character/levelUpSpells.ts: UNMODELED_SPELL_GRANT_FEATURES (~540) holds the bonus-cantrip entry and is emitted unsupported at ~823. The feature spell-choice path in the same file handles structured cantrip/spell choices on target features.
- packages/core/src/character/levelUpFeatureChoices.ts: LIST_CHOICE_CATEGORIES includes 'other'. A feature choice with an inline options[] catalog and from: string[] is detected, validated and persisted on CharacterSheet.featureChoices automatically.
- packages/core/src/character/levelUpEngine.ts detectLevelUpRequiredChoices(): targetFeatureRefs = class row refs + existing subclass refs at toLevel + newly selected subclass refs; legacy fallback descriptors; coveredFeatureRefs.
- packages/core/src/rules/repeatedFeatureChoices.ts: source level vs grant level for choice instances.
- Known unmodeled subclass build choices: circle-of-the-land:bonus-cantrip (L2, one druid cantrip), circle-of-the-land:circle-spells (L3, choose the land), college-of-lore:bonus-proficiencies (L3, three skills of your choice), draconic-bloodline:dragon-ancestor (L1, dragon type). These are EXPECTED members, NOT the closed set.

DESIGN DECISIONS (supervisor):
1. Audit gate: replace grantedClassFeatureLevels with a grant-graph enumerator covering class progression featureGrant rows AND subclass-granted features at their subclass levels (including level-1 subclasses: cleric, sorcerer, warlock). Use it in both checkChoiceCoverage and checkSubclassChoiceCoverage. Add CHOICE_SIGNALS that catch the new prose shapes ("<n> skills of your choice" / proficiency with skills of your choice -> category 'skill'; choosing a land -> 'other'; choosing a dragon type/ancestor -> 'other'), each tested against the full feature text in the pack. FIRST run the widened gate BEFORE adding any curated choices and record the full finding list in your bead notes. Every finding must then be modeled or carry a named `unsupported` marker. Report any finding beyond the four known ones explicitly.
2. Pack (deriveFeatureChoices.ts + regenerate via `npm run import:dnd5e-srd` per the protocol; also run `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack`):
   - bonus-cantrip: {id:'bonus-cantrip', category:'cantrip', choose:1, level:2, from: spellFilter({classLists:['class:druid'], level 0 ...})}, shaped exactly like the existing cantrip filters.
   - circle-spells: {id:'land', category:'other', choose:1, level:3, from:[ids], options:[...]} with one option per land in the SRD Circle Spells tables (arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, swamp), option ids `land:<slug>`. Option text is verbatim source text (each land's table/heading content as the pack's source region carries it). No invented text.
   - bonus-proficiencies (Lore): {id:'skills', category:'skill', choose:3, level:3, from: a structured filter or the 18 SRD skill names; follow any existing 'skill' category precedent in deriveFeatureChoices}.
   - dragon-ancestor: {id:'dragon-ancestor', category:'other', choose:1, level:1, options: the 10 Draconic Ancestry table rows (dragon + damage type), ids `dragon-ancestor:<slug>`}. Creation-time consumption is eshyra-nnj6's job, not yours. Append a note on eshyra-nnj6 saying the choice now exists in the pack.
3. Engine:
   - Delete the bonus-cantrip UNMODELED_SPELL_GRANT_FEATURES entry. If the map is then empty, remove the map and its emitter. Prove that a Land druid 1->2 now gets a SUPPORTED druid-cantrip choice through the feature spell-choice path and can apply it.
   - Land at L3 is handled by the existing list path (category 'other'). Verify detection, application and featureChoices persistence. Consuming always-prepared circle spells is eshyra-odpc: append a note there saying where the land choice persists.
   - Lore skills: new small module packages/core/src/character/levelUpSkillChoices.ts. Descriptor kind 'class-feature-choice', status supported, id descriptorId(toLevel, featureRef, 'skills'), choose 3, options = skills NOT already in sheet.skillProficiencies. Validation: exact count, distinct, eligible. Apply: append to sheet.skillProficiencies (same string form the sheet uses) AND record a featureChoices entry, with a ledger row. Keep the levelUpEngine.ts diff to minimal wiring. A parallel dispatch (eshyra-ug4i.1.1, expertise) is editing levelUpEngine.ts and levelUpFeatureChoices.ts, so keep your edits there small and localized.
   - GENERALIZED ENGINE INVARIANT (the bead requires it): after all detectors run, every choice instance available at toLevel on a target feature ref (use repeatedFeatureChoices' instance semantics for level matching) must be covered by some emitted descriptor with that featureRef (supported or unsupported). Any uncovered instance, including explicit `unsupported` markers on the record, gets a generic unsupported 'class-feature-choice' descriptor, id descriptorId(toLevel, ref, choiceId), naming the feature and choice. Do this in one place (e.g. a coverage pass in levelUpEngine.ts or a helper module), never per-feature. Then run the level-up test suite and an enumeration over every class/subclass x level 1->20 transition. List in your notes every transition the invariant NEWLY blocks. If an instance is not a build choice at all (a use-time choice such as which Channel Divinity effect to use when activating it), do not block on it: fix the classification at its source (the pack's category/marker, or an explicit, documented non-build-choice predicate) and report it. Do not silently exempt anything.
4. Creation side: do NOT implement level-1 class/subclass choice collection (eshyra-nnj6). Just confirm the audit covers the level-1 subclass features.

EVIDENCE (proportionate; extend the existing test files):
- Audit: the widened gate run on the pre-fix pack yields exactly the recorded findings (put the list in notes), and is clean after the fix. Keep one focused regression proving a subclass-granted feature is in the audited universe.
- Engine: Land druid 1->2 cantrip apply; Land druid 2->3 land pick persisted; Lore bard 2->3 three skills appended (refuses held/duplicate/wrong count); invariant: a synthetic or real uncovered choice instance yields an unsupported descriptor.
- `npm run verify:worktree` before committing. Commit the regenerated pack artifacts together with the importer change.
notes:
Dispatched 2026-10-09 to Sonnet 5.5 Claude Agent (background), worktree .worktrees/eshyra-91o0.1, parallel with eshyra-ug4i.1.1 (overlap: levelUpEngine.ts wiring; supervisor resolves at integration).
COMPLETION (commit fd5a1236 on eshyra-91o0.1; verify:worktree: 331 files passed / 2 skipped, 6066 tests passed / 3 skipped).

PRE-FIX WIDENED-GATE FINDINGS: grantedFeatureLevels (class featureGrant rows + subclass featuresByLevel/features slots incl. L1 subclasses) with the OLD signals found only feature:circle-of-the-land:bonus-cantrip (cantrip). With the three new signals (skills of your choice; choose that/a/the land; choose one type of dragon) the full list on the unchanged pack was exactly four, nothing beyond the known set: bonus-cantrip (L2, cantrip), circle-spells (L3, other), college-of-lore:bonus-proficiencies (L3, skill), draconic-bloodline:dragon-ancestor (L1, other). Gate is [] after the fix. A broad prose scan (choos|select|of your choice|determine...) of every subclass feature found no other build choice; fiendish-resilience (damage type at each rest) and Draconic Presence 'awe or fear' are use-time, not build.

MODELED (deriveFeatureChoices.ts; emit.ts passes tableRecords; pack regenerated via import:dnd5e-srd --out data dir, verify:dnd5e-srd-pack green): bonus-cantrip = cantrip choose 1 L2 druid level-0 spellFilter; circle-spells = id 'land', category other, choose 1, L3, 7 options land:<slug> whose text is rendered from the printed table:circle-of-the-land-<land> rows; bonus-proficiencies = id 'skills', category skill, choose 3 (parsed, fail-closed), L3, from the 18 SRD_5_1_SKILLS; dragon-ancestor = category other, choose 1, L1, 10 options dragon-ancestor:<slug> from table:draconic-bloodline-draconic-ancestry ('Dragon: Black; Damage Type: Acid'). Generated diff = only those four feature records.

ENGINE: removed UNMODELED_SPELL_GRANT_FEATURES map + emitter (levelUpSpells.ts). Land druid 1->2 now gets a SUPPORTED cantrip choice via the feature spell-choice path and applies (tested). Land 2->3 land pick goes through the existing list path, persisted on featureChoices (featureRef feature:circle-of-the-land:circle-spells, choiceId land, optionIds [land:x]). New levelUpSkillChoices.ts (descriptor/validate/apply: exact count, distinct, eligible, not held; appends sheet.skillProficiencies, writes featureChoices entry, ledger row via choicesApplied.skillProficiencies). New levelUpChoiceCoverage.ts invariant, wired once at the end of detectLevelUpRequiredChoices. levelUpEngine.ts diff is small: 3 imports, skillChoice/skillProficiencies type fields, one detector call, one invariant call, one resolve branch, skillProficiencies in applyChangeSetToSheet.

INVARIANT: for each target feature ref with no emitted descriptor (by featureRef or canonical descriptor id), every choice instance at toLevel (exact-level entries if any, else all entries) gets an unsupported class-feature-choice descriptor id descriptorId(toLevel,ref,choiceId). NEWLY BLOCKED TRANSITIONS in the shipped pack (enumerated every class x subclass x level 1->19 incl. subclass-selected-in-same-step): NONE, after two documented exemptions. (a) use-time: pack choices with category channelDivinity + unsupported marker are excluded by isUseTimeChoice (the marker's own reason says which effect to invoke is a per-use decision; fixed as a narrow documented predicate rather than blocking cleric/paladin L2/L3 etc). (b) base Spellcasting/Pact Magic features are owned wholesale by levelUpSpells.ts under level.N.spells.* ids that carry no featureRef; counted covered when that module emitted any descriptor at the level (without this the invariant falsely blocked paladin 1->2 and ranger 1->2). Pre-exemption, the only hits were those two classes. Synthetic uncovered choice is proven to yield an unsupported descriptor.

TESTS: levelUpSubclassChoices.test.ts (new; Land cantrip apply, land persist+ledger, Lore skills append/persist/ledger + refusals: too few/many, held, duplicate, non-skill; dragon ancestor pack shape; invariant synthetic + Channel Divinity + full enumeration); srdPlayabilityAudit.test.ts (subclass-only-granted feature is in the audited universe; real-pack text of the four features fires the gate when choices are stripped); deriveFeatureChoices.test.ts (skills/land/dragon derivation + fail-closed); levelUpSpellSelection.test.ts fail-closed test rewritten.

DEVIATIONS: (1) new test file instead of extending levelUpFeatureChoices.test.ts, to avoid conflicts with the parallel expertise dispatch. (2) levelUpSpellSelection.test.ts 'feature that grants a spell without a structured choice is unsupported' asserted the old UNMODELED map behavior, which is now wrong by design (requirement changed: pack models the choice); replaced by a supported-Bonus-Cantrip test plus a synthetic pack-marked-unsupported test. (3) Baselines updated because four features became modeled, per their own stale-key mechanisms: ACCEPTED_PROSE_RECORD_KEYS drops bonus-cantrip and circle-spells (create-dnd5e-srd-audit-bundle/cli.ts), srdGeneratedPack feature.choices missingCount 124->120, docs/inventories o9bd-18-8-8 regenerated via its script. (4) Lore apply test strips bard :expertise from the L3 row because Expertise (separate bead) still blocks bard L3. (5) Option ids for skills are the skill names (e.g. 'Arcana'), the form the sheet already uses.

FOLLOW-UPS: always-prepared circle spells consumption -> eshyra-odpc; level-1 dragon ancestor collection -> eshyra-nnj6.
